name: ČSFD Rating
description: Fetches movie ratings from ČSFD and stores them in the native critic rating field.
overview: ČSFD ratings as native critic rating

versions.changelog: Series support (ČSFD seriály), unmatched-items report in settings, minimum-votes threshold (default 100), staleness-aware monthly refresh task, improved matching (exact-title priority, film-page verification for all matches), Anubis cookie persistence, HTTP hardening (pinned redirects, response caps, backoff)
Better matching: film-page verification pass (handles ČSFD omitting original-name on exact search hits), superscript/fraction title normalization, per-title logging in the backfill task
Initial release: ČSFD ratings as native critic rating for movies, Anubis PoW support, ČSFD external links
